title: add benchmark lab adaptive batching reporting pipeline v86
author: Priya Kaur
description: Add adaptive-batching reporting pipeline (v86) to benchmark-lab. This PR wires up new representative workload runners to the reporting pipeline, updates profiling baselines for adaptive batching, and adds end-to-end aggregation + dashboarding hooks. Motivation: recent infra changes exposed variance in batch size selection for small payloads which made tail-latency profiling noisy; this pipeline produces per-variant summaries and per-sequence-length histograms that feed the latency/cost dashboards. Changes include new runner wrappers, CI test harness for the pipeline, lightweight SQL schema migration for the reporting DB, and a small set of metrics (batch_size_distribution, adaptive_batch_decision_rate, per_prompt_kv_cache_hit). See Linear ENG-3645 for acceptance criteria and SUP-1124 for incident context. Checklist: - [x] representative runners added for chat/text/embedding workloads - [x] profiling baseline generation job added and scheduled - [x] reporting aggregation job with export to dashboard created - [x] CI integration tests for the pipeline - [x] docs and runbook updated with troubleshooting steps. Links: internal doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3645/adaptive-batching-v86, dashboard proto: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/bench/adaptive-batching-v86.
